overview_description.description: Addenda is a blockchain-based insurtech startup that uses the blockchain to share insurance information. The company is based in Dubai, UAE. Addenda is an AI-powered SaaS platform that helps businesses digitize and automate operational workflows. It provides modular solutions for industries like insurance, automotive, healthcare, and facility management, focusing on areas such as claims processing, vehicle inspections, appointment scheduling, and workflow automation. The platform uses AI to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and speed up business operations.

product.name: Addenda Claims
product.description: An AI-powered platform that manages the entire motor insurance claims process, from incident reporting to repair completion, integrating insurers, repair shops, and customers.

product.name: Addenda Vision
product.description: An AI-driven vehicle inspection tool that detects damage types, vehicle details, and estimates repair costs from images to support insurers and repair services.

product.name: Addenda Repair
product.description: A comprehensive AI-powered repair shop management solution that automates workflows, technician scheduling, and repair estimation from booking to vehicle delivery.

product.name: Addenda MIRSAAS
product.description: A platform for motor insurance operations that automates claims intimation, recoveries, salvage management, and approvals with AI-powered document processing.

product.name: Addenda FNOL
product.description: A web application that enables customers to report vehicle incidents instantly using AI-driven image analysis for fast and accurate First Notice of Loss capture.

product.name: Addenda Quote
product.description: An AI-powered solution that provides fast and accurate vehicle repair cost estimates, integrating with GT Estimate for precise parts and labor pricing.
